parsed.rationale: Regular sinus rhythm at about 50 bpm (sinus bradycardia) with a normal PR interval, narrow QRS and normal axis, no LVH voltage (S V3 + R V5 is about 26 mm), and only mild concave ST elevation with upright T waves in V2–V4 (a benign early-repolarization pattern), so STEMI criteria are not met.
